notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for callback enable and disable around standard per-object attribute-relevance advisories. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies unnamed and named update-rate turn-up/turn-down advisory suppression, callback release after re-enable, callback-model servicing, object and attribute identity, update-rate metadata, declaration cleanup, and federation lifecycle without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador callback enable/disable and callback-servicing controls with ordinary object publication/subscription and FederateAmbassador turnUpdatesOnForObjectInstance/turnUpdatesOffForObjectInstance delivery
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador callback-control and per-object attribute-relevance declarations
